Title: Storage Ultra Disks meter name change

Body.Content:
Effective October 1, 2019, the meter (also known as resource GUID) names for Ultra Disks in US East 2 regions will change.

You will need to modify billing routines that rely on the meter’s naming attributes.

See the table below for name change details.
